keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «미라 만들기는 죽은 몸이 썩지 않게 지키는 방법이다(주제)» 와 «미라는 옛사람들이 어떻게 살았고, 무엇을 먹었고, 어떤 병을 앓았는지 알려 준다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (mummification is a way of keeping a dead body from decaying) and the conclusion (mummies help us learn how people lived, what they ate, and what illnesses they had). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why did Egyptians usually leave the heart inside the body?
qs.qko: 이집트 사람들은 왜 보통 심장을 몸 안에 남겨 두었나요?
opts: Because they believed the heart was the center of thoughts and feelings
Because the heart was too small to take out
Because the heart helped dry the body
evs: They believed the heart was the center of a person's thoughts and feelings.
First, they removed most of the organs, but they usually left the heart inside.
Next, they covered the body with a special salt called natron to dry it out for about 40 days.
Ancient Egyptians believed that the body was needed in the afterlife.
why: 심장이 사람의 생각과 감정의 중심이라고 믿었기 때문이에요. «심장을 남겨 두었다» 는 문장은 사실만 말하고, 그 까닭은 다음 문장에 있어요.
They believed the heart was the center of a person’s thoughts and feelings. The sentence about leaving the heart gives the fact, and the next sentence gives the reason.

qs.q: In “keeping a dead body from decaying,” what does “decaying” mean?
qs.qko: «keeping a dead body from decaying» 에서 «decaying» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: slowly going bad and breaking down
evs: How could it last so long?
The Chinchorro people of South America made mummies even earlier.
Finally, the body was wrapped in long strips of linen cloth.
why: 바로 앞에서 «몸이 어떻게 그렇게 오래 남아 있을 수 있었을까?» 하고 물었고, 그 답이 미라 만들기예요. 오래 남아 있는 것의 반대이니, «decaying» 은 몸이 «서서히 썩어 없어지는 것» 이에요.
The text asks how the body could last so long, and the answer is mummification. Decaying is the opposite of lasting: slowly going bad and breaking down.

qs.q: Which is true about the first people to make mummies?
qs.qko: 처음으로 미라를 만든 사람들에 대해 맞는 것은 무엇인가요?
opts: The Chinchorro people of South America made mummies before the Egyptians
Tutankhamun was the first person to make a mummy
evs: Surprisingly, Egypt was not the first place to make mummies.
The Chinchorro people of South America made mummies even earlier.
In November 1922, Howard Carter held up a candle and peered through a small hole into a dark tomb.
It was the tomb of Tutankhamun, a young Egyptian king who died more than 3,000 years ago.
why: «이집트가 미라를 처음 만든 곳이 아니다» 와 «남아메리카의 친초로 사람들이 더 먼저 미라를 만들었다» 를 이어야 답이 나와요.
Egypt was not the first place to make mummies, and the Chinchorro people of South America made them even earlier. You need both sentences.
